reviews.body:
Nice follow-through from #1899, and running the test over the plain, `us.` and `global.` IDs is exactly the right shape.

One ask before this goes in: Converse accepts any model ID, so the matcher should cover every current Claude model that rejects sampling, not just the three #1899 had table entries for. The `@ai-sdk/anthropic` model catalog also marks `claude-haiku-5-5`, `claude-fable-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-opus-4-7` and `claude-opus-4-8` as rejecting `temperature`/`top_p`, so `--explain` with those still gets the 400 on this branch.

Matching on `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`, `claude-fable-5`, `claude-opus-4-7` and `claude-opus-4-8` covers all of them, and none of those substrings hit the 4.5/4.6 IDs that still accept sampling. A few more model IDs in the test table would pin it, plus one case like `anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5` that should keep `Temperature`.

CI is green at `c1682c8`, so with that this is good to go from my side.

Thanks @pcbeingused333, that's exactly what I asked for.

Delta checked at `fb2ec1d`: `bedrockRejectsSampling` now matches `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`, `claude-fable-5`, `claude-opus-4-7` and `claude-opus-4-8`, which is the set the `@ai-sdk/anthropic` catalog marks as rejecting `temperature`/`top_p`. None of those substrings match the 4.5/4.6 IDs, and the new `SamplingAcceptingModels` test pins that `Temperature` still goes out for them. The extra IDs in the rejecting table cover the plain, `us.` and `global.` forms. The `ConverseInput` alignment fix is a nice bonus.

If a matched model did accept sampling, the only effect is that it runs on its defaults, so a miss here is harmless. Build, lint, tests and `validate` are green at this head.

Good to merge.
